description: Smartphones under Rs. 30,000 offer a range of features, from high-refresh-rate displays and large batteries to versatile cameras and long-term software support. The Poco X8 5G stands out with its 9,000mAh battery, while the Redmi Note 17 5G packs an 8,000mAh cell. The Nothing Phone (4b) features its distinctive Glyph Bar, and the Samsung Galaxy M47 5G promises six years of security updates. The OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite offers a 144Hz display at a lower starting price.
title: Best Value for Money Smartphones Under Rs 30,000 in India

description: MacBook Pro (M6) starts at Rs. 2,39,900 in India for the 14-inch model with 16GB of unified memory and 1TB of SSD storage. The new model is suited to users who need faster processing, graphics, and AI performance. The MacBook Pro (M5), however, has a lower starting price. What are the key differences between the MacBook Pro (M6) and MacBook Pro (M5), and which one should you consider buying? Here's a detailed comparison.
title: MacBook Pro (M6) vs MacBook Pro (M5): Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Apple has just launched its latest mini tablet called the iPad Mini (2026). The tablet directly competes with Oppo’s Pad Mini, which was recently launched in India with a similar asking price. We take a closer look at what’s new and what’s different between the two mini tablets.
title: Apple iPad Mini (2026) vs Oppo Pad Mini: Here’s What’s Different?

description: A CIBIL Score is a numerical summary of your credit history. This figure is calculated using the details given by banks and other financial institutions. It reflects your past borrowing and repayment behaviour. The CIBIL Score allows lenders to understand the risk associated with extending credit. If your CIBIL Score is lower than expected, following responsible credit habits can help strengthen your credit profile over time.
title: How to Check CIBIL Score for Free Online: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Microsoft allows users to take screenshots on a Windows 11 laptop in multiple ways. One of the most useful tools for taking screenshots is the built-in Snipping Tool in Windows 11. You can use the Snipping Tool by searching for the app in the Start menu. It lets users take screenshots, record the screen, and screenshot specific parts of the screen. You can even use the app for quick markup to annotate or add text by using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + E. An even faster method to get to the Snipping Tool app is by using the keyboard shortcut. You can press the Windows Key + Shift + S to directly open the Snipping Tool on your Windows 11 laptop. All the functionalities remain the same as mentioned above. The screenshots are saved in the “Screenshots” folder in the “Pictures” file on your device.
title: How to Take Screenshot on Laptop: 7 Different Ways to Take a Screenshot in Windows 11

description: Once known as the budget smartphone segment, the sub-Rs 15,000 category is now India's entry-level segment. Rising memory prices have forced manufacturers to trim hardware and features. As a result, we are left with smartphones that just get the job done and deliver the bare minimum.
title: Best Value For Money Mobile Phones Under Rs. 15,000 in India

description: Teardown of the Galaxy Fit 4 Manager app reportedly shows that the Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 could offer many features similar to those available on the Galaxy Fit 3. The app reportedly includes a new banner. It could support up to 12 tiles. The fitness tracker is tipped to offer sleep tracking, heart rate monitoring, and high-stress alerts. The Galaxy Fit 4 is expected to be available in Black, Silver, and Light Green colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 Features Allegedly Revealed Through Companion App Teardown
